Gear up for the ultimate part-time job! 🚀
Join us as a foodora Courier. Experience or no experience, we will teach all you need to know! Ready to roll? Apply now as a Rider.
What we offer:
Average earnings of 180kr per hour

Enjoy the flexibility to set your own working hours – work when it suits you! 🕒

Gear up! We’ll provide bag, clothing and other accessories for the job at no cost 🕶️

More than just a ride - join the foodora Rider Community

What you need to have:
Your personal vehicle – a car registered in Sweden, let’s roll! 🚗

A smartphone – to start your city adventures! 📱

The right to work in Sweden, including the following: 

Valid Work Permit (if not EU/EEA citizen) 

Personal Number or Coordination Number 

Swedish Drivers Licence or EU/EEA Drivers Licence (only if you are EU/EEA citizen) 

Swedish bank account

Basic language skills in English or Swedish

👉 Apply now! 

Gör dig redo för det ultimata extrajobbet! 🚀
Bli ett foodora-bud. Erfarenhet eller ingen erfarenhet, vi lär dig allt du behöver veta! Redo att rulla? Ansök nu som Rider.
Vad vi erbjuder: 
Genomsnittlig timlön på 180 kr 

Njut av flexibiliteten att välja dina egna arbetstider - arbeta när det passar dig! 🕒

Utrustning! Vi tillhandahåller väska, kläder och andra tillbehör för jobbet utan kostnad 🕶️

Mer än bara en åktur - bli en del av foodora Rider-gemenskapen

Vad du behöver ha: 
Ditt egna fordon - en svenskregistrerad bil, låt oss rulla! 🚗

En smartphone - för att starta dina stadsäventyr! 📱

Rätt att arbeta i Sverige, inklusive följande:

Giltigt arbetstillstånd (om du inte är EU/EES-medborgare) 

Personnummer eller samordningsnummer 

Svenskt körkort eller EU/EES-körkort (endast om du är EU/EES-medborgare)

Svenskt bankkonto

About the assignment We are looking for an experienced security governance professional to join an international team delivering a secure private cloud environment. The assignment starts in January 2027 and runs for approximately 18 months. You will work onsite in Luxembourg around 40–60% of the time, with the remainder remote.
What you will do Your mission is to guide the solution towards formal security accreditation and authorisation to operate. In practice, you will:

Define the scope of the accreditation together with stakeholders, and set up governance and a structured approach to evidence

Gather and organise the security standards and requirements that apply

Review evidence across people, processes and technology, and evaluate it against agreed criteria

Keep a clear record of requirements, findings, gaps, decisions and remediation priorities

Lead review sessions with the customer and NATO accreditation authorities

Deliver a complete, traceable accreditation package, including workbook, evidence and open actions, ready for handover

What we are looking for

Solid experience of security accreditation, certification or compliance work in complex environments

Strong knowledge of NIST and ISO 27001, and experience mapping controls to government cloud frameworks

Familiarity with SSP, ST&E and POA&M, as well as defining system boundaries

Experience with gap analysis, risk assessment and remediation planning

Understanding of the compliance challenges in air-gapped/isolated environments

Fluent English, written and spoken

Requirements

Valid NATO security clearance (or eligibility to hold one)

Ability to work onsite in Luxembourg part of the week

Why join us? At CyberInstincts, you will be part of a specialist cybersecurity community working on high-impact assignments. We offer flexibility in how we work together, as an employee or as an independent consultant, and support you throughout the assignment.
Interested? Apply with your CV and a brief description of your accreditation experience. We review applications continuously, so don’t wait to apply.
